notes.title: Demo v25.9.8 patch notes
notes.content: [p]Hey![/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback on the demo. I’m continuing development, and the first step is addressing some of the main frustrations you pointed out.[/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tile Numbers[/b] - Adjusted to give clearer information and reduce guesswork (RNG).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corruption System[/b] - Removed “?” indicators to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][/list][p]More improvements are on the way as development continues! I know there's still some other frustrations commented in the feedback, so I'll tackle those next.[/p][p]Got more ideas? Join the conversation on [url="https://discord.com/invite/JbEmu7pJQj"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Demo Feedback & What’s Next
notes.content: [p]Hey![/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and shared their thoughts, all your feedback has been incredibly helpful.[/p][p]Before moving into adding functionality, I think I'll need to address your most common frustrations, which seem to centre around:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]trap system[/b], especially the lack of clarity about how many are nearby[/p][/*][*][p]The general [b]randomness[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The [b]uncertainty[/b] before the fights (e.g. not knowing if you can defeat a Tier X enemy)[/p][/*][*][p]And overall [b]balance issues[/b] across the levels[/p][/*][/list][p]These will be my top priorities moving forward. I’ll be working hard to improve these systems and make sure the experience feels fair, strategic, and rewarding.[/p][p]Feel free to drop your ideas in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/JbEmu7pJQj"]Discord [/url]channel too![/p]
